target_market: Local electronics retail, starting with urgent, specification-sensitive purchases
primary_persona: A shopper who needs a compatible laptop charger today, and wants to avoid a wasted store visit
secondary_persona: A local electronics merchant who can confirm stock, provide product evidence, and receive qualified enquiries
flagship_scenario: Compatible 65W USB-C PD laptop charger under INR 1000 near Thane
problem_claim: Local recommendations can rely on unsupported availability and compatibility claims, causing uncertainty and potentially wasted visits
value_proposition: Show what evidence supports a local purchasing option, what remains unverified, and which next check is most useful
differentiation_hypothesis: Evidence provenance, actionable uncertainty, next-best-proof selection, and auditable replanning are more useful than a lowest-price-only recommendation
commercial_hypothesis: Merchants may pay for qualified leads or verification-and-insights tools if the workflow reduces effort and brings measurable incremental value
business_questions: How frequently do shoppers encounter a store-level stock or compatibility mismatch?
How much time does a typical shopper spend confirming availability before visiting?
Would a shopper choose a verified-but-slightly-higher-priced option?
Can a merchant submit or update evidence in less than two minutes?
What would persuade a merchant to keep claims current?
Who would pay for verification and what is the willingness to pay?
What is the cost per verified decision, including AI, infrastructure, and merchant effort?
What changes when merchant evidence conflicts or expires?

metrics.label: Unsupported recommendation rate
metrics.formula: unsupported recommended options / all recommended options

metrics.label: Correct safe abstention rate
metrics.formula: correctly withheld unsafe/unsupported recommendations / unsafe or unsupported cases

metrics.label: Useful decision rate
metrics.formula: cases with correct actionable decision / all evaluated cases

metrics.label: Time to decision
metrics.formula: median elapsed seconds from customer request to decision

metrics.label: Merchant effort to submit evidence
metrics.formula: median seconds needed for a consenting merchant to provide and update an evidence claim

metrics.label: Measured unit cost per decision
metrics.formula: attributable model, hosting and workflow spending / completed decisions

metrics.label: Observed prevented wasted trips
metrics.formula: observed avoided trips with independent counterfactual or appropriately qualified estimate

business_risks.risk: Merchants do not participate or do not refresh claims
business_risks.mitigation: Consent-based small pilot; measure time per update and freshness

business_risks.risk: Merchant assertion mistaken for independently verified stock
business_risks.mitigation: Explicit source classification; no unverified purchase authorization

business_risks.risk: Google Shopping and inventory networks have existing distribution
business_risks.mitigation: Benchmark next-best-proof and contradiction handling rather than generic discovery

business_risks.risk: Model and API calls make economics unattractive
business_risks.mitigation: Measure service cost per journey with controlled usage

business_risks.risk: Benchmarks reward refusal instead of useful outcomes
business_risks.mitigation: Measure correct abstention alongside useful decision coverage
Mark sample size, participant selection, and limitations

success_criteria: One fresh Google AI request is schema validated (17B; live testing requires approval)
One newly supplied evidence change causes real Python recomputation (17C)
Every claim has a source, timestamp, and verification type (17D)
A meaningful next verification is selected and justified (17E)
Reproducible baseline benchmark reports both improvements and failures (17F)
A consenting merchant/shopper pilot tests usability if feasible (18A)
Measured latency, reliability, and unit economics are reported (18B)
Presentation clearly separates live behavior, emulation, and replay (18C)
